input.task: What is the total on the case-twins order summary?

provenance: PR #60 R5: T-M42-20 fixed half the round trip. A `near` anchor is quoted off the SAME observation a name is, so on a `text-transform: uppercase` table the only spelling a planner can write is the shouted one — and `_nearest`'s exact pass was still `get_by_text(near, exact=True)`, case-sensitive. `case-twins.html`'s summary table is uppercased by stylesheet only (`<th>Total</th>` renders as `TOTAL`), with `Subtotal of Total line` beside it as the substring trap that keeps the exact pass load-bearing. The fix reuses `_whole_string` for that pass, so it stays whole-string — the substring pass is still a separate, later rung and `near-anchor-substring` still grades what it always did.

triage.red_first: on `fbe304b`: `ResolveError: proximity to 'TOTAL' does not identify one element for {'role': 'cell', 'near': 'TOTAL'}` — the exact pass found 0 and the substring pass found 2 (`Total` and `Subtotal of Total line`). The spelling that DID resolve, `near: 'Total'`, is a string the observation never contains.
triage.note: This closes the anchor's exact pass only; `resolve_advertised` still feeds names, not anchors, so nothing grades the anchor half of the round trip generically. Declared in docs/support-matrix.md rather than left implicit.
